scripts.build: pnpm resolve-dependencies && pnpm build:lib && pnpm build:example && pnpm allow-read-write
scripts.build:example:native: pnpm exec lz-tool --docker-platform native --script 'anchor build --no-idl --ignore-keys' anchor
scripts.build:lib:native: pnpm exec lz-tool --docker-platform native --script 'cargo build' anchor
scripts.build:native: pnpm resolve-dependencies && pnpm build:lib:native && pnpm build:example:native && pnpm allow-read-write
scripts.lint: pnpm resolve-dependencies && pnpm exec lz-tool --script 'cargo +nightly-2025-06-01 fmt -- --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings' anchor
scripts.test:example: pnpm resolve-dependencies && pnpm exec lz-tool --script 'cargo test --manifest-path macros/examples/vault/Cargo.toml --lib --tests' anchor
scripts.test:rust: pnpm resolve-dependencies && pnpm exec lz-tool --script 'cargo test -p rbac --lib --tests' anchor
